City Council/Successor Agency Special Meetings
CITY COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY SPECIAL MEETINGS
CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBER
38300 SIERRA HIGHWAY, SUITE B
PALMDALE, CALIFORNIA
TUESDAY, DECEMBER 01, 2020
6:00 P.M.
www.cityofpalmdaleca.gov
WELCOME
6:15 PM & 7:00 PM
IMPORTANT PUBLIC HEALTH AND SAFETY MESSAGE REGARDING PARTICIPATION AT CITY COUNCIL MEETINGS
As a result of the COVID-19 emergency, and resulting orders and direction from the President of the United States, the Governor of the State of California, and the County of Los Angeles Department of Public Health, as well as the City of Palmdale emergency declaration, the public will not be permitted to physically attend the City Council meeting. Councilmembers may choose to participate via conference call.
How to Observe the Meeting:
1) Spectrum local access Channel 27
2) Online live webcast at cityofpalmdale.org.
How to Submit Public Comments through Palmdale eComments on this Agenda:
Note: Public Comments submitted will become part of the official meeting record.
1)Go to the Agendas & Minutes webpage at https://cityofpalmdale.org/310/City-Council-Meetings and find this meeting under Upcoming Events; 2) Click on the eComment button; and 3) Scroll through the agenda to find the agenda item for which you would like to provide a comment and submit your comment.
Please note: The City Council is making every effort to follow the spirit and intent of the Brown Act and other applicable laws regulating the conduct of public meetings in order to maximize transparency and public access.
In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related modification or accommodation to participate in this meeting, please call the City Clerk’s Office at (661) 267-5151 at least 72 hours prior to the meeting.
1. CALL TO ORDER 6:15 P.M. CLOSED SESSION MEETING.
2. ROLL CALL: MAYOR HOFBAUER, MAYOR PRO TEM LOA, COUNCILMEMBERS BETTENCOURT, CARRILLO, AND BISHOP
3. PUBLIC COMMENTS RECEIVED ON CLOSED SESSION ITEMS.
4. PRESENTATION BY CITY ATTORNEY/GENERAL COUNSEL of the following item(s) to be discussed in Closed Session:
4.1 CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL--POSSIBLE LITIGATION
Significant exposure to litigation pursuant to paragraph (2) of subdivision (d) of Section 54956.9: Number of cases – One.
Closed session is recommended because the Successor Agency will assess the merits of this matter and consider the Successor Agency's perspective. Based on existing facts and circumstances, there is a significant exposure to litigation against the Successor Agency. The existing facts and circumstances that might result in litigation against the Successor Agency are 1) The Successor Agency terminated a Purchase and Sale Agreement, dated September 20, 2017, between the Successor Agency and Ben Sayani and Fariborz Matian; 2) On June 29, 2020, Ben Sayani and Fariborz Matian issued a letter to the escrow agent claiming that the Purchase and Sale Agreement could not be terminated because of pending "epidemics" and "quarantine restrictions," and directed the escrow agent not to cancel the escrow; and 3) it is likely that the Successor Agency will have to initiate or defend a lawsuit to resolve the dispute regarding the Purchase and Sale Agreement and associated escrow. Based on the existing facts and circumstances, it is the opinion of General Counsel that it would prejudice the position of the Successor Agency to discuss this matter in public or to disclose further the circumstances in this potential case. Further, such disclosure may harm any settlement attempts or other efforts to resolve the matter without litigation.
4.2 CONFERENCE WITH LABOR NEGOTIATORS
City representatives: City Manager, Assistant City Manager & Human Resources Manager
Unrepresented employee: All Unrepresented Employees
This Closed Session is being held pursuant to the authority of California Government Code Section 54957.6.
4.3 CONFERENCE WITH LABOR NEGOTIATORS
City representatives: City Manager, Assistant City Manager & Human Resources Manager
Employee Organization: California Teamsters Local 911 Public, Professional & Medical Employees Union (on behalf of City Maintenance Staff)
This Closed Session is being held pursuant to the authority of California Government Code Section 54957.6.
5. CLOSED SESSION
6. ANNOUNCEMENT BY CITY ATTORNEY/GENERAL COUNSEL of item(s) discussed in Closed Session
7. ADJOURN 6:15 PM. CLOSED SESSION MEETING
8. CALL TO ORDER 7:00 P.M. MEETING.
9. PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND MOMENT OF SILENCE IN HONOR OF OUR TROOPS.
10. ROLL CALL: MAYOR HOFBAUER, MAYOR PRO TEM LOA, COUNCILMEMBERS BETTENCOURT, CARRILLO, AND BISHOP
11. CONSENT CALENDAR:
11.1 Authorize the City Manager to Negotiate the Terms and Conditions of the License Agreement with SIFI Networks Palmdale, LLC for the Installation of Fiber Optics in the Public Right-of Way to Provide Fast and Reliable Internet-Service Throughout the City. (Staff Reference: Director of Public Works Heffernan)
Staff Recommendation: Staff Recommendation: A. Authorize the City Manager to negotiate terms and conditions of the License Agreement in the best interest of the City and report back to the City Council the final terms of the agreement; and B. Authorize the City Manager or his designee to execute the License Agreement with SiFi Networks Palmdale, LLC., including all minor and non-substantive changes. (Voice Vote - Requires a majority vote to approve.)
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM 11.1
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM 11.1
12. CITY COUNCIL COMMENTS.
13. ADJOURNMENT.
